systems.system: registration of births and deaths by municipalities
systems.platform: not stated; the document says no central archive is kept
paper ID since 1980; no unique ID number and no central electronic database
systems.owner: the police, under the Ministry of Interior
systems.tiers: citizens aged 16 and older; a birth certificate is among the supporting documents
pilot launched 2013; nationwide rollout being planned as of 2017

systems.owner: UNHCR, on behalf of the government

note: Section 5.1 (research of 2017) states that municipalities register births and deaths and that no central archive is kept, but does not say how the municipal record is made, so no value of 'made', 'events' or 'offices' is stated. Its other Burundi figures are coverage of people, not offices: birth registration 75.2% (DHS 2010), 75% of under-fives (UNICEF), official identification 71% (ID4D 2017).
